name: bld4_pisano_prime_dvd_pred_of_isSquare_five
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hp5 : p ≠ 5) (h : IsSquare (5 : ZMod p)) : p3_pisano p ∣ p - 1
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hp5 : p ≠ 5) (h : IsSquare (5 : ZMod p)), p3_pisano p ∣ p - 1
informal: Uses Mathlib2.p3_aux_fib_prime, Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff and Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period: by Euler's criterion (ZMod.euler_criterion) 5^(p/2) = 1 in ZMod p, so p3_aux_fib_prime gives F_p ≡ 1 and 2F_{p+1} − F_p ≡ 1, hence F_{p+1} ≡ 1 and F_{p−1} = F_{p+1} − F_p ≡ 0 mod p. lib_fib_period_iff (with m = p − 1) turns this into p − 1 being a period, and bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period concludes.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], p ≠ 2 → p ≠ 5 → IsSquare 5 → Mathlib2.p3_pisano p ∣ p - 1
